entities.name: Aetherwing
entities.description: A legendary aether-powered airship, the Golden-Scale Flagship, built by Saheeli and seen on Avishkar during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: A large golden skyship, the Kaladeshi Consulate's Flagship on Avishkar.

entities.name: Akroma's Memorial
entities.description: A large white stone memorial statue of Akroma that existed during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria.

entities.name: Helm of the Host
entities.description: A legendary helm that serves as the crown of the queen of Vesuva, worn by Omo and, in the Un-iverse, Solaflora.

entities.name: Jodah's Mirror
entities.description: A magical mirror Jodah received from Voska that aided him many times and finally ignited Jaya Ballard's spark.

entities.name: Mox Amber
entities.description: A legendary mox of amber on a pendant, said to be a moment in time made tangible.

entities.name: Reaver Cleaver
entities.description: An axe used during the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria that turns blood or body parts into valuable materials.

entities.name: Thran Temporal Gateway
entities.description: A Thran portal from the past on Dominaria.

entities.name: Thrumming Stone
entities.description: A tall stone obelisk found in the snowy mountains of Terisiare at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Timeless Lotus
entities.description: A glowing white lotus growing out of the hand of one of Urza's destroyed war machines.

entities.name: Wand of Ith
entities.description: An artifact created by Lord Ith, stolen and used by Mairsil to drain Primata Delphine's magical defenses.

entities.name: Throne of Eldraine
entities.description: The throne of the High King of Eldraine, a red and gold chair with banners of the five realms.

entities.name: Slayer's Bounty
entities.description: A wanted-poster spellbook from Innistrad depicting a werewolf to be hunted.

entities.name: Enigma Jewel
entities.description: A legendary artifact on Ixalan that transforms into the Locus of Enlightenment.

entities.name: Locus of Enlightenment
entities.description: An Ixalan artifact created from the Enigma Jewel.

entities.name: Everflowing Well
entities.description: A stone well on Ixalan that flows into the Myriad Pools.

entities.name: Indomitable
entities.description: A named pirate ship seen on Ixalan.

entities.name: Millennium Calendar
entities.description: A giant metal calendar on Ixalan that tracks time.

entities.name: Skullspore Nexus
entities.description: An Ixalan stone dais with a mushroom-covered dinosaur skull that creates Fungus Dinosaurs.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A silver compass pointing toward planeswalking magic, given by Nicol Bolas to Vraska to find the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Thousand Moons Smithy
entities.description: A magical smithy in Ixalan's Core operated by Gnomes to create Gnome Soldiers.

entities.name: Eater of Virtue
entities.description: A blade from Kamigawa that eats the soul of those who die wielding it.

entities.name: Chronicle of Victory
entities.description: A tapestry from Lorwyn depicting the plane's united victory over the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Gem of Becoming
entities.description: A legendary gem on the Meditation Plane possibly connected to the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Mindslaver
entities.description: A metal helmet from Mirrodin that mind controls the wearer.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
entities.description: A statue of Nicol Bolas on Ravnica toppled by Vitu-Ghazi during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
entities.description: The throne of the leader of the Mardu Horde in Tarkir's original timeline, formed from Kolaghan's skull.

entities.name: Stormforged Armor
entities.description: A set of Mardu armor with conductive orbs of electricity.

entities.name: Hall of Triumph
entities.description: A Theros hall featuring a statue of Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Nyx Lotus
entities.description: A large pink and purple lotus located in Nyx.

entities.name: Dominion Bracelet
entities.description: Sunstar Free Company equipment from the Edge, a white metallic bracelet with a red crystal.

entities.name: Eternity Elevator
entities.description: A massive Pinnacle Eternity column rising from a planet into space.

entities.name: Chromatic Orrery
entities.description: A public model of New Phyrexia with spheres for the plane and its moons.

entities.name: Terminus of Return
entities.description: A Terminus Stone that brings creatures back to life, presumed one of six such stones.

entities.name: Tome of the Infinite
entities.description: A book containing numerous powerful spells.

entities.name: Kindslaver
entities.description: A mechanical helmet from Bablovia in the Un-iverse, a reference to the Mindslaver.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: The builder of Aetherwing.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Recipient of a Reflecting Mirror from Voska.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Usurped his teacher Ith's position as leader of the Conclave of Mages and stole the Wand of Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Creator of the Wand of Ith and former leader of the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader stabbed to death by Mairsil during her assault on the Conclave.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Gave the Thaumatic Compass to Vraska; statue of him toppled in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Received the compass to find the Immortal Sun in Orazca and kept it in her Ravnica apartment.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Honored by a memorial statue on Dominaria.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Toppled the God-Pharaoh's Statue during the war.

events.summary: Mairsil usurps his teacher Ith's position and steals the Wand of Ith.
events.quote: When Mairsil usurped his teacher's position, he stole the wand and used it for himself.

events.summary: Mairsil uses the wand to drain Primata Delphine's defenses and stabs her to death during her assault on the Conclave.
events.quote: draining away her magical defenses and then stabbing her to death

events.summary: Jodah's Mirror ignites Jaya Ballard's spark as its final action.
events.quote: as its final action igniting Jaya Ballard 's spark

events.summary: Nicol Bolas gives the Thaumatic Compass to Vraska to find the Immortal Sun in Orazca; she keeps it afterward on Ravnica.
events.quote: to assist her in finding the Immortal Sun in the city of Orazca on Ixalan

events.summary: Vitu-Ghazi topples the statue of Nicol Bolas during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: a statue of Nicol Bolas that was later toppled by Vitu-Ghazi during the war
